title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 7: Kaori Asou
native_title: プラドル・ディスク Ｖｏｌ．７ ～麻生かおり～
overview: Private Idol Disc Vol. 7: Asou Kaori is a multimedia photobook of gravure idol Kaori Asou. It includes a gallery of photos and video interviews, as well as a simple rock-paper-scissors minigame and a quiz minigame. Completing the minigames will unlock bonus photos.
